findings.claim: Illustrative row: offshore protective coating systems are typically specified against a recognised standard such as NORSOK M-501 or ISO 12944.
Illustrative row: thermally sprayed aluminium is one option among several for splash-zone protection; selection depends on design life and maintenance access.
Illustrative row: post-combustion carbon capture cost estimates vary widely with plant configuration and are usually reported per tonne of CO2 captured.
Illustrative row: zero-trust architecture guidance is published by several national standards bodies; NIST SP 800-207 is one such document.
Illustrative row: BIM submission requirements differ between public-sector clients; the level of model detail required is usually stated per deliverable.
